fields.summary: Planned the milestone 'Make Rex run as a background daemon on Linux and move this installation to a dedicated VM'. Rex's Linux server already runs under systemd and keeps sessions across restarts, so the work is Rhiza's: the daemon must run without a Rex tab of its own. Decided: done means a headless daemon plus actually moving this installation; on a server the daemon is a systemd service installed by rhiza daemon install, never in a tab, but each installation chooses service or tab (the Mac keeps the tab), so start/stop must handle both; run tabs open in a fixed per-repo Rex session; the daemon self-updates from main for now, from releases later; notifications stay Rex only; a new Ubuntu Server 26 VM on Proxmox; the move is captured in an HTML runbook like the afk one. Three change sets, all planned now: daemon as a service, self-update from main, move to the VM. Open: who carries out the VM build itself.
